rows.notes: The study is a meta-analysis (Materials and Methods: data retrieved from Web of Science, Google Scholar and CNKI; 3130 Dra and 1303 CU observations from 29 published studies; log-response ratios with random-effects model). Per the rating rules a meta-analysis is not a primary study, so Q1 is 'no' and Q2-Q9 follow. For reference only: the pooled results (Fig. 2) show Dra falling from 96.1% to 64.2% and CU from 93.3% to 58.1% between <125 h and 375-500 h of cumulative operation under reclaimed-wastewater drip irrigation, which is the finding the passage summarises; 95% CIs are reported for pooled effects, but none of this counts as the study's own primary evidence.
